get.description: Store-scoped dashboard overview for KPI cards, order-status rings, revenue series, completed-orders series, top selling products, and recent orders. Optional revenueFrom/revenueTo and completedFrom/completedTo only affect the revenue and completedOrders sections.

parameters.name: revenueFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive start date for Total Revenue Earned. Defaults to Jan 1 of the current calendar year.

parameters.name: revenueTo
parameters.description: Inclusive end date for Total Revenue Earned. Defaults to Dec 31 of the current calendar year.

parameters.name: completedFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive start date for Completed orders over time. Defaults to the first day of the current calendar month.

parameters.name: completedTo
parameters.description: Inclusive end date for Completed orders over time. Defaults to the last day of the current calendar month.

200.description:
Returns dashboard metrics shaped for the admin overview screen:
- kpis: orders/products/customers/shipments totals with month deltas
- orderStatus: pending (PENDING|CONFIRMED|PROCESSING), inTransit (SHIPPED), delivered
- revenue: PAID order totals for the revenue date window (default current calendar year) with monthly points and previous-window changePercent
- completedOrders: DELIVERED counts for the completed date window (default current calendar month) with weekly points and previous-window changePercent
- topSellingProducts: top 5 products by sold quantity (non-cancelled orders)
- newOrders: latest 5 orders

Query params revenueFrom/revenueTo and completedFrom/completedTo are optional ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD).
